description:
THE 1487
Full serviced apartments at the centre of Munich.
Tenancy from 2 to 5 months.
THE 1487. Pure. Home.

Official home
THE 1487 in Munich offers 26 furnished, full serviced apartments from 2 up to 3.5 rooms. All units possess bathrooms with washer-dryer and are fitted with fully-equipped kitchens and high-class bed and living rooms. Underground parking in the basement garage and a weekly cleaning service can be booked as an extra option.
from 2 – 3.5 rooms; starting 3,103 EUR/mthly; for 2 – 5 months.

Truly Convenient Living
Feel at Home
Ample rooms, high-quality facilities, elegant furniture and interior decoration that exhibits our love for details: all of this makes THE 1487 a special kind of corporate housing. Especially people who only need a temporary accommodation will be able to feel right at home and appreciate the advantages compared to staying at a hotel. ‘Arrive and start living’ is the principle that guided us in developing this housing complex.

Living facilities designed to meet your wishes
All units outfitted with patio, loggia or balcony
Fully-equipped kitchen with stove, oven and dish washer
Bathroom with on-grade shower and washer-dryer
Flat screen TV and SONOS sound system
Free Wi-Fi
Elegant designer furniture
Parquet floor in all bed and living rooms
Solid wood double beds with anti-allergic bedding
Underground parking (subject to availability)
Cleaning and laundry service on demand
Fully inclusive rent

Right at the centre of Munich
And still an oasis of calm and comfort.
THE 1487 is located conveniently close to the city centre (not far from the Hackerbrücke and only one S-Bahn-stop from the central train station) while still providing a calm and shielded living environment. All means of public transport are within walking distance, while the middle ring road can be accessed by car in only a few minutes. The building is located at the back of a courtyard, shielded from city noise. An elaborate garden area creates a beautiful and cosy living environment.

Well-provided-for – in THE 1487 and in the vicinity
Weekly apartment cleaning service on demand
Parcel station “My Renzbox” in the house
Restaurants, bars and cafés of any price range in the vicinity
Variety of grocery stores within walking distance
A number of gyms located nearby
Cooperation with dry cleaners “Jonny Fresh”

Official German home
Möblierte Wohnungen auf Zeit mitten in München.
Vermietung für 2 bis 5 Monate.
THE 1487 in München bietet 26 vollausgestattete Wohnungen mit 2 bis 3,5 Zimmern. Alle Einheiten verfügen über Bäder mit eigenem Wasch-Trockner, komplett ausgestattete Küchen und hochwertig eingerichtete Wohn- und Schlafzimmer. Tiefgaragen-Stellplätze und die wöchentliche Reinigung können optional dazu gebucht werden.
ab 3.103 EUR/mtl. für 2 – 5 Monate.
Purer Komfort / Wohngenuss wie Zuhause
Großzügige Grundrisse, hochwertige Ausstattung sowie die stilvolle Möblierung und Einrichtung mit viel Liebe zum Detail machen THE 1487 zu einem Boarding House der besonderen Art. Vor allem Menschen, die nur zeitlichbefristet Wohnraum benötigen, werden sich hier sofort wohl fühlen und die Vorzüge gegenüber einem Hotel zuschätzen wissen. Ankommen und sofort losleben ist die Devise, nach der das Konzept des Hauses entwickeltwurde.
Die Ausstattung der möblierten Wohnungen lässt keine Wünsche offen.

Zentral in München. Und dennoch eine ruhige Wohlfühloase.
Unweit der Hackerbrücke und nur eine S-Bahn-Station vom Münchener Hauptbahnhof entfernt, liegt THE 1487absolut zentrumsnah, aber dennoch ruhig und abgeschirmt.

Official apartments hub
Our apartment types
We offer 26 full serviced apartments from 2 to 3.5 rooms, between 63 and 120 square metres in size. They can be rented from 2 to 5 months; there is a possibility of extension for another month. There is also the option to obtain a parking space in the basement garage and book additional services like weekly apartment cleaning. All our apartments are outfitted with either a patio, a loggia or a rooftop balcony as well as a lockable cellar compartment.

Exquisite interiors
We are convinced that temporary accommodation has to provide a certain quality of living and a homely atmosphere. Therefore, we have furnished all our apartments with high-quality brands, designer furniture and thoughtfully-selected accessories. Parquet floors and ceramic tiles are a matter of course.
In THE 1487, we have everything covered: from a fully-equipped kitchen to towels and bedding. Just feel at home!

Official location
Located at the centre of Munich.
THE 1487 is located on Landsberger Str. 10, very close to the city centre of Munich. The building is situated at the back of a quiet courtyard. There are public transport stops on the doorstep (tramline 18 and 19) or 5 minutes on foot at the Hackbrücke (S-Bahn). Traveling by car, you are well connected due to the building’s proximity to the middle ring road. Using various public transport options, you will be able to reach the inner city in less than 10 minutes and the airport in approx. 45 minutes. Grocery stores and a variety of bars and restaurants are located within walking distance.
